## Icon mapping (all verified against the baked SDF atlas, `runtime/icons/baked-names.ts` — the SdfIcon fast path, so no tofu fallback)

| Control | Form | Glyph |
|---|---|---|
| PAINT arm/disarm | icon toggle (On variant when armed) | `Paintbrush` — deliberately distinct from the Build tools' `Brush` (paint-material), the very collision the user called out |
| MODE PAINT/ERASE echo | **killed** — one `Eraser` icon toggle: off = paint, accent-on = erase. The mode name is never spelled next to itself; also avoids a second Brush glyph colliding with the terrain Brush tool |
| Channel TERRAIN | icon | `Mountain` |
| Channel TILE | icon | `Grid3x3` |
| Channel WATER | icon | `Waves` |
| Channel FLORA | icon | `Leaf` |
| Channel ZONE | icon | `LandPlot` |
| Channel ROAD | icon | `Route` |
| Terrain BRUSH | icon | `Brush` |
| Terrain RAMP | icon | `TriangleRight` (right-triangle = literal ramp profile) |
| Terrain SLOPE | icon | `MoveUpRight` (diagonal grade) |
| Terrain SMOOTH | icon | `Blend` |
| SAVE | icon | `Save` |
| Road COMMIT / CANCEL | icons (verbs) | `Check` (accent) / `X` |
| Road SIDEWALKS | icon toggle | `Footprints` |
| Zone "+ ZONE" add | icon (verb) | `Plus` |

**Stayed text (value readouts, per the law):** SHAPE/PROF cycle pills, SIZE/HEIGHT/LOW/HIGH/WIDE/STR and LANES steppers, TEXTURE binding pill (shows the bound material name — a value), road `N PTS · M ROADS` stats. **RAISE/DIG — my call:** converted from a bare on/off pill to the bar's labeled cycle readout `DIR RAISE`/`DIR DIG` (the SNAP/SHAPE convention) — it's a value the brush carries (which direction height moves), not a mode name, and up/down-arrow glyphs would lie next to the ▼/▲ floor steppers a few slots away.

- `ToolOptions.tsx` and `workspace.cls.ts` needed **no changes** — placement was already right and the existing HW_IconButton/HW_IconButtonOn classes covered everything; no new classes appended.

Visible: the action bar's leftmost control is now the Paintbrush icon toggle before the divider — no "PAINT" word anywhere, glyph renders crisp (no missing-glyph box), visually distinct from the smaller Brush in the Build tool group. The armed segment (channels/tools/erase/save) can't be shown headless since paint isn't armed, as expected; all its glyph names were membership-checked against BAKED_ICON_NAMES.
- Honest note: the crop shows the pre-existing floor-down `▼` text button hugging the SNAP pill's "edge" label tightly — that's ToolOptions' existing floor control, untouched and out of my scope.
